title: 🟢 ZNS Solana Creator Challenge
gate_reasons: Requires launching a real token on ZNS Launchpad (Solana) which entails on-chain transaction fees and wallet interaction that cannot be performed without real funds and a funded signer.

Eligibility requires achieving $500 organic trading volume and 5 unique holders within the bounty period — this depends on external human participants and cannot be autonomously manufactured or guaranteed.
Submission mandates providing a wallet address used to create the token and social/community URLs; identity-linked artifacts and public social presence constitute a human-identity gate.
Judging criteria include community activity and overall quality/originality, which are subjective evaluations by the ZNS team and not verifiable or satisfiable through automated execution alone.
notes: AGENT_ALLOWED flag is present but scope is fundamentally a social/trading competition requiring real users, real funds, and human identity. No autonomous path to qualified submission exists.
